Cure All.name: Cure All
Cure All.description: Removes Poison, Disease, and heals 3d6 damage to all body areas.

Dust of Vanishing.name: Dust of Vanishing
Dust of Vanishing.description: Causes what it is used on to remain invisible so long as no strong wind blows the dust off or sudden movements shake it off.

Fairy Dust.name: Fairy Dust
Fairy Dust.description: Allows one being to fly for the duration.

Snake Oil.name: Snake Oil
Snake Oil.description: The drinker breaks out in a sweat that is oily. That sweat makes the surface of the being`s body more and more slippery until they cannot stand or even wear certain articles of clothing. Effect takes 10-40 seconds to fully manifest.

Dragon`s Breath.name: Dragon`s Breath
Dragon`s Breath.description: Does 1d4 (cold), 1d6 (fire), 1d8 (electricity) or 1d10 (acid) per Title of the invoker in a breath cone of 2` long and 1` radius at the base per Class Title of the breather. After the imbiber breathes 3 times the effect ends.

Cup of Confusion.name: Cup of Confusion
Cup of Confusion.description: Causes auditory hallucinations with feelings of euphoria, and a 20% chance of visual hallucinations. Grants +3 to STR and VIT. -3 to all Mental Attributes. A very high pain threshold is granted reducing all damage occurrences by 2 points. Lie skill is reduced by 50%.

Earthen Stout.name: Earthen Stout
Earthen Stout.description: Grants +30% to Poison and Disease Resistance, new resistances if currently inflicted. Immune to effects which halt or alter movement and effects which cause sleep or drowsiness.

Gout Soup.name: Gout Soup
Gout Soup.description: Grants +20% Disease Resistance, +1 Vitality, reduction of fever, swelling, and pain, +1d4+1 Endurance. Has very high pain threshold, reducing all damage by 2 points per occurrences.

Healer`s Balm.name: Healer`s Balm
Healer`s Balm.description: Heals 4d6+4 damage to all body areas.

Herb-Soaked Bandages.name: Herb-Soaked Bandages
Herb-Soaked Bandages.description: Each strip heals 1d4+1 if the wound is fresh (binding) and an additional 3d4+3 from the herbal infusion. It will also cure gangrene and blood poisoning if it is that body area.

Infused Fruit.name: Infused Fruit
Infused Fruit.description: Grants +1d4 to all physical Attributes. +20 Endurance. Immune to fear (and any control which would make someone run away). Immune to Shock. Immune to fatigue. Also counts as a full day`s food and drink.

Mystic Marvel.name: Mystic Marvel
Mystic Marvel.description: Grants +1d4+1 Intelligence, +1d4+1 Aura, +(1-2) Will Force, +1d4+1 Aura Control, and Improved Telepathy.

Planewalker`s Balm.name: Planewalker`s Balm
Planewalker`s Balm.description: Grants Immunity to Cold/Heat/Electricity/Acid/Pressure and gains magical flight.

Rheumatic Oil.name: Rheumatic Oil
Rheumatic Oil.description: Reduces joint pain, and makes joints work more effectively. +1 temporary Agility, +10% to skills that use Agility. +10% to Agility saves.

Undead Paste.name: Undead Paste
Undead Paste.description: Can Life Sense up to 60`. Immune to the draining, disease, and/or poison effects of all Undead. Cannot be sensed by undead (those with physical eyes can still see them). All undead must make a Control Resistance to approach within 20`. Even if the Control Resistance is made, they must make another to attack. All undead compulsions are suppressed by any undead within 100` of the protected individual.
